models_evaluated: hybrid chatbot (rule-based stage-of-change component plus natural language processing component)
unlisted_practices: Stage-of-change-tailored hybrid chatbot (rule-based plus NLP) for promoting vaccination uptake compared with a standard video link intervention

screen.reason: This is a randomized clinical trial assessing the real-world deployment and efficacy of an NLP/rule-based hybrid chatbot vs standard educational video link to increase pneumococcal vaccination among older adults. It evaluates the chatbot intervention overall rather than testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
